people.name: George I, King of the Hellenes

body.zh-Hant: 喬治一世原名威廉（丹麥文 Vilhelm），1845年12月24日生於哥本哈根，是丹麥國王克里斯蒂安九世的次子，在哥本哈根規模不大的宮廷中長大；他1861年進入海軍軍官學校就讀。
body.en: George I was born Wilhelm (Danish Vilhelm) on 24 December 1845 in Copenhagen, the second son of the Danish king Christian IX, and grew up at the small Copenhagen court; in 1861 he entered the naval cadet academy.

heading.en: Election as King of the Hellenes

body.zh-Hant: 1862年奧托國王被推翻後，希臘制憲國民議會於1863年3月30日一致選出威廉為國王，他以「希臘人的國王」的稱號、喬治之名即位；這項選擇出自保護國法國、英國與俄國的屬意。9月17日他離開哥本哈根，10月30日抵達新王國。英國為此放棄對愛奧尼亞群島的控制；丹麥傳記辭典說他把這些島嶼當作「見面禮」帶來。1863年他另列名丹麥海軍上將。
body.en: After King Otto was overthrown in 1862, the Greek constituent national assembly unanimously elected Wilhelm king on 30 March 1863; he took the title King of the Hellenes under the name George. The choice followed a designation by the three protecting powers, France, Britain and Russia. On 17 September he left Copenhagen and on 30 October reached his new kingdom. Britain gave up its control over the Ionian Islands in his favour; the Danish dictionary says he brought the islands as a morning gift. In 1863 he was also listed as an admiral of the Danish fleet.

heading.en: The first decades of the reign

body.zh-Hant: 1866年喬治一世協助起義的克里特人對抗土耳其，1867年他在聖彼得堡與俄國女大公奧爾加·康斯坦丁諾芙娜成婚。丹麥傳記辭典說，在他近五十年的統治下，希臘徹底改觀；靠他在英國的人脈，希臘在1881年於色薩利獲得大幅擴張，義大利百科則記該省1880年才併入希臘。1897年因克里特引發的戰爭他無法阻止，但王位撐過了這場震盪。
body.en: In 1866 George helped the Cretans who rose against Turkey, and in 1867 he married Grand Duchess Olga Konstantinovna in St Petersburg. The Danish dictionary says that under his reign of almost fifty years the country was completely transformed; thanks to his personal connections in England Greece gained large extensions in Thessaly in 1881, whereas the Italian encyclopedia says the province was annexed only in 1880. He could not prevent the war of 1897 over Crete, but the throne withstood the shocks it caused.

citations.quote: Nel 1866 re G. cercò di estendere il territorio nazionale

Gift 27.10. 1867 i St. Petersborg med storfyrstinde Olga Konstantinovna
under G.s næsten 50-årige regering undergik landet en fuldstændig forvandling
På grund af kongens personlige forbindelser navnlig i England
fik Grækenland 1881 store udvidelser i Thessalien
solo nel 1880 quella provincia poté essere annessa al territorio greco
kunne han ikke afværge krigen 1897 om Kreta
men tronen modstod de rystelser denne katastrofe gav anledning til

body.zh-Hant: 丹麥傳記辭典記載，1912至1913年征服希臘最後一批北方省份的行動是在他的領導下進行的；義大利百科說，土耳其向同盟的保加利亞與塞爾維亞宣戰後，希臘也對蘇丹宣戰，而國王沒能見到希臘的勝利。他在部隊勝利進入塞薩洛尼基、距離五十週年在位紀念只差數週時，被一名精神失常的兇手殺害。GND 記其死於1913年3月18日的塞薩洛尼基，他葬於雅典近郊的塔托伊。
body.en: The Danish dictionary records that in 1912-13 the conquest of the last Greek provinces in the north took place under his leadership; the Italian encyclopedia says that when Turkey declared war on the allied Bulgaria and Serbia, Greece in turn declared war on the sultan, and that the king died without seeing Greece's victory. He fell to the hand of an insane murderer during the troops' victorious entry into Thessaloniki, a few weeks before his fiftieth jubilee. The GND records his death in Thessaloniki on 18 March 1913; he was buried at Tatoi near Athens.

body.zh-Hant: 約翰·尼高斯沃爾1879年9月6日出生，父親安德斯是佃農（husmann），母親是安德烈亞·拉特沃爾。1897年父親去世，18歲的他成為家中的生計支柱；1901年他與阿爾比內·布蘭茲萊特成婚。他1902至1907年在美國從事鐵路工程等工作，在加拿大與美國期間曾自稱約翰·韋斯特比（John Westby），因為本名太難讀。
body.en: Johan Nygaardsvold was born on 6 September 1879, the son of the crofter (husmann) Anders Nygaardsvold and Andrea Ratvold. His father died in 1897 and the 18-year-old became the family's provider; in 1901 he married Albine Regine Brandslet. From 1902 to 1907 he worked in the United States, including on railway construction, and in Canada and the USA he called himself John Westby because his real name had become too difficult.

citations.quote: Født 06.09.1879 i Strinda, Sør-Trøndelag
Sønn av husmann Anders Nygaardsvold (1839-1897) og Andrea Ratvold (1845-1929)
I 1897 døydde faren, og 18-årige Johan overtok som familieforsørgar.

Arbeidet på jernbaneanlegg i USA 1902-1907
der han budde frå 1902 til 1907

body.zh-Hant: 1909年他在赫梅爾維克（Hommelvik）找到工作；1910至1915年他是馬爾維克（Malvik）學校董事會成員，1911至1914年任工人聯合會（Arbeidsmandsforbundet）赫梅爾維克分會主席，1914至1916年任赫梅爾維克合作社董事會主席，國會傳記並記他1913至1916年為馬爾維克議會議員。1915年當地黨員推舉他為工黨在斯特林達選區的國會候選人，他雖不情願，仍然當選。
body.en: In 1909 he found work at Hommelvik. From 1910 to 1915 he sat on the school board of Malvik, from 1911 to 1914 he chaired the Hommelvik branch of the Labourers' Union (Arbeidsmandsforbundet), and from 1914 to 1916 he chaired the board of the Hommelvik cooperative society; the parliamentary biography also lists him on the Malvik municipal council in 1913-1916. In 1915 local party colleagues made him, reluctantly, the Labour Party's Storting candidate for the Strinda district, and he was elected.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會議員、市長與黨內職務
heading.en: Member of parliament, mayor and party offices

body.zh-Hant: 國會傳記顯示，他自1916年起代表斯特林達選區（後為南特倫德拉格）進入國會，屬工黨。他1919至1922年任馬爾維克市長，1923年起成為工黨全國理事會（landsstyre）成員，1924至1926年任南特倫德拉格工黨主席，1925至1926年任赫梅爾維克工黨主席。1920年共產國際在莫斯科通過「莫斯科提綱」時，他是反對者之一。
body.en: The parliamentary biography shows him sitting for the Strinda district (later Sør-Trøndelag) from 1916 for the Labour Party. He was mayor of Malvik in 1919-1922, a member of the Labour Party's national board (landsstyre) from 1923, chairman of the Sør-Trøndelag Labour Party in 1924-1926 and of the Hommelvik Labour Party in 1925-1926. When the Communist congress in Moscow adopted the so-called Moscow Theses in 1920, he was one of the opponents.

heading.en: Minister, Storting offices and party-group leader

body.zh-Hant: 1928年1月28日至2月15日他在霍恩斯魯德（Hornsrud）政府任農業部長，這屆政府只維持不到三週。他1929至1933年任上院（Lagting）議長，1932至1935年任國會黨團主席，1934至1935年任國會議長。他在1933年與農民黨達成的危機協議中扮演關鍵角色，1935年據此組成工黨政府。
body.en: From 28 January to 15 February 1928 he was minister of agriculture in the Hornsrud government, which lasted only a little under three weeks. He was president of the Lagting in 1929-1933, chairman of the Storting group in 1932-1935 and president of the Storting in 1934-1935. He was central in shaping the 1933 crisis compromise with the Farmers' Party, on the basis of which he formed a Labour government in 1935.

heading.zh-Hant: 首相任內與戰時流亡政府
heading.en: Prime minister and the wartime government in exile

body.zh-Hant: 國會傳記記載他1935年3月20日至1945年6月25日任首相，並於1935年3月20日至1939年10月2日兼任勞工部的代管部長。社會政策上，養老保險法最重要，失業保險法1938年出台。德軍1940年入侵挪威時，他是最先拒絕德方最後通牒的人之一；1940年6月7日他與國王離開挪威，GND 記他1940至1945年領導倫敦流亡政府。1945年6月12日他的政府遞出辭呈。
body.en: The parliamentary biography records him as prime minister from 20 March 1935 to 25 June 1945 and, from 20 March 1935 to 2 October 1939, as managing minister of the Ministry of Labour. In social policy the old-age pension law was the most important, and the unemployment insurance law came in 1938. When Germany attacked Norway in 1940 he was among the first to reject the German ultimatum; on 7 June 1940 he left Norway together with the king, and the GND records him as head of the exile government in London in 1940-1945. On 12 June 1945 his government submitted its resignation.

heading.en: After the war and final years

body.zh-Hant: 他1945年10月再度當選國會議員，並任職到1949年。1945年調查委員會對他的政府戰前的備戰不足提出批評，但肯定其在倫敦的工作。1949年他獲頒金質公民勇氣獎章（Borgerdådsmedaljen），同年退出國會、回到赫梅爾維克；他在1952年3月13日去世，遺作《我的童年與青年》於1953年出版。
body.en: He was re-elected to the Storting in October 1945 and served until 1949. The 1945 Investigation Commission could not absolve his government of part of the responsibility for the lack of defence preparedness before the outbreak of war but credited its work in London. In 1949 he received the Gold Medal for Civic Merit (Borgerdådsmedaljen) and left the Storting, returning to Hommelvik; he died on 13 March 1952, and his memoir of childhood and youth appeared in 1953.

body.zh-Hant: 胡安·何塞·德阿梅薩加1881年1月28日生於蒙特維多，法律專業，1905年取得法學學位。他著有法學著作，包括《民法教學》（1908年）；烏拉圭國會圖書館的目錄也收有他的《過失責任》與《契約過失》等著作。
body.en: Juan José de Amézaga was born in Montevideo on 28 January 1881 and was a jurist; he received his law degree in 1905. He wrote legal works, including Enseñanza del derecho civil (1908); the catalogue of the Library of the Uruguayan Legislative Power also lists his Culpa aquiliana and Culpa contractual.

body.zh-Hant: 取得學位後，他當過哲學教授、勞工局局長，兩度代表杜拉斯諾省出任眾議員，並擔任工業部長；1916年出任駐阿根廷大使，並擔任中等教育顧問，1918年任國家保險銀行行長，另擔任烏拉圭中央鐵路公司的律師。
body.en: After his law degree he was a professor of philosophy and director of the Labor Office, twice a representative for the department of Durazno, and minister of industry; in 1916 he was ambassador to Argentina, he served as an adviser on secondary education, in 1918 he was president of the State Insurance Bank, and he was attorney for the Central Railroad of Uruguay.

body.zh-Hant: 他當選時，烏拉圭正走出一個十年的制度變動：1933年由總統加夫列爾·特拉的政變開啟，1942年以其繼任者巴爾多米爾將軍的政變告終；巴爾多米爾保證自由選舉並恢復民主。在這次新的選舉中，科羅拉多黨與他靠推動巴特列主義獲勝。百科記他為1943至1947年的烏拉圭總統，並說他的當選確保烏拉圭在戰時站在同盟國一邊。他另著有《國際史的一章》（1942年）。
body.en: He was elected as Uruguay emerged from a decade of institutional changes begun in 1933 by President Gabriel Terra's coup and ending with the coup of his successor, General Alfredo Baldomir, in 1942; Baldomir guaranteed free elections and a restoration of democracy. In the new electoral process the Colorado Party and Amézaga emerged triumphant by promoting Batllismo. The encyclopedia records him as president of Uruguay in 1943-1947 and says his election guaranteed that Uruguay would be aligned with the Allied cause. He also wrote Un capítulo de historia internacional (1942).
